title: The Workflow host must carry the typed review-verdict when its review/PR path is built
description:
From b50, the tick that gave the review a typed verdict on the local host.

b50 added the verdict where the Go reconciler records and reads it. The Workflow-hosted reconciler has no review/PR path yet — cxk is building it — so there is nothing there to carry the field through today. When cxk's path lands, the verdict must ride with it: a NOT READY review recorded on the cloud host as ready-to-merge would be the same defect b50 just fixed, in the host Phase 5 exists to prove.

This is the 'indistinguishable records' rule again (z23's acceptance): a run on either host must produce records a reader cannot tell apart.

Reported by b50, run epic-dha, finding 0e8939e7.
acceptance_criteria: A review's typed verdict is recorded and read identically by the Workflow host and the Go reconciler, with a test that a NOT READY review on the cloud host is never recorded as ready-to-merge
